story.red_reign.red_reign_take_world: A red reign is taking over the world
advancement.red_reign.activate_altar_of_: What did you do? Steve, She is free! It was really inevitable.
advancement.red_reign.life_cost_crafting: Are your hands still clean? Tools infused with vitality.
item.red_reign.common.hold_shift: Hold down the §6Shift§r to view the item's abilities.
item.red_reign.vampire_rose.lore: A relic given as a gift to express gratitude for one's freedom. During the day, it may dry out a little, but its bloodthirsty power remains.
item.red_reign.intrinsic_mechanism.lore: We, the metalworking villagers, are increasingly setting aside our swords, tools and armor and embracing advanced mechanical technology.
item.red_reign.catalyst_of_everything.lo: Everything?! Sculk, Nether, The End, Overworld, Soul, Portal, Meat, Mind.
item.red_reign.chalice_of_the_bloodblade: What's in this chalice? Who knows?! At least it tastes good and can be refilled.
When attacking enemies, your Life Steal does not restore health to the wearer, but instead stores vitality in the chalice itself.
item.red_reign.totem_of_the_red_queen.lo: A mysterious totem covered in a rare and extremely durable material. It reacts strangely when it witnesses life slipping away.
item.red_reign.totem_of_the_red_queen.ab: Grants the Undying effect, but restores (Life Steal)% of your Maximum Health and then disappears.
item.red_reign.purification_spell.lore: This ancient spell promises to purify red things... Like a poppy!
item.red_reign.purification_spell.abilit: Use it in your Main Hand, paired with a Poppy in Off-Hand, and complete the purification.
item.red_reign.crystallized_tear.lore: This crystallized tear is the embodiment of memories belonging to a former white monarch.
item.red_reign.final_blessing.lore: A keychain containing the petrified tongue of a clergyman.
item.red_reign.allay_cage.lore: Interact with an Allay and it will let you catch it easily! I'll admit, the amethyst and its apparent love of being trapped really help with the capture.
item.red_reign.ethereal_protection.lore: A censer that emits the essence of Allay.
item.red_reign.earthly_ichor.lore: A substance similar to the ichor of the gods, but produced on Earth. Mortals can consume it to gain more vitality.
item.red_reign.healing_bulb.lore: This suction pear can be attached to the back with two small punctures and keep the wearer's internal organs in place for longer.
item.red_reign.lazuli_providence.lore: A pure and simple start. Stylish earrings that call for a little extra charm and rumor has it that lapis lazuli brings good luck.
item.red_reign.daisy_silver_meteor.lore: The beauty of a daisy. The weight of a meteor. The shine of silver. The magic of...
item.red_reign.daisy_silver_meteor.abili: The XP costs of the anvils used by the wearer are reduced by 50%.
When the wearer uses an anvil, the chance of it being damaged is reduced by 50%.
item.red_reign.coral_gauntlet.lore: I can feel this gauntlet pulsing... Is it called "coral" because of its color or its material?
item.red_reign.coral_gauntlet.ability1: When the wearer's target has 25% or less of its maximum health, the wearer's attack deals 35% increased damage and restores health equal to 10% of the damage dealt.
item.red_reign.rose_anchor.lore: With this belt, the wearer becomes steady, hard as sto... Rose quartz?
item.red_reign.vortex_pearl.lore: A pearl necklace that swirls through the wearer's armor like a vortex.
item.red_reign.amethyst_resonator.lore: It reproduces sound and electrical waves. Caution! Risk of hearing loss and electric shock.
item.red_reign.red_identity.lore: When wearing this mask of pure red, the wearer loses all sense of their own identity, hides behind a power devoid of guilt and frees themselves from ethical constraints.
item.red_reign.red_identity.ability1: Increases damage dealt by 0–20% based on the amount of health lost (100–1%).
item.red_reign.red_signet.lore: This ring is the ultimate sign of Her approval. The red power flows more intensely.
item.red_reign.red_signet.ability1: The wearer gains 1.4x the benefit from Life Steal.
item.red_reign.red_signet.ability2: Allows the wearer to use the Purification Spell.
